facts.business: The Orissa Minerals Development Company Limited is engaged in mining and mineral development operations, primarily iron ore and manganese ore mining in Odisha.

auditor.name: SDR & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on internal financial controls due to material weaknesses in capital expenditure budget adherence, stripping cost accounting controls, and balance confirmation procedures. Emphasis of matter on retrospective correction of stripping costs (Rs.91.32 lakh) and additional provision for arbitration award (Rs.863.77 lakh).

key_risks: Material weaknesses in internal financial controls over capital expenditure, stripping cost accounting, and balance confirmations
Legal and arbitration liabilities (Rs.1740.99 lakh provision for Jai Balaji Industries award)
Dependence on government policies and approvals as a Central Public Sector Enterprise
Fluctuations in global and domestic mineral prices and demand
Environmental and regulatory compliance risks in mining operations
